prompt_md: IX is nine in Roman numerals. Add a single letter to IX to make it six. Which letter do you add?
prompt_short: Add one letter to IX to make six. Which letter?
hint_md: Six does not have to be written in Roman numerals.
explain_intuition_md: Roman thinking points to V or I, and neither works without moving letters. Put an S in front and IX spells SIX.
explain_math_md: No math here: the trick is in the wording.
